title.zh: 将甲米地省塔加伊泰市圣何塞、托伦蒂诺东与西、弗朗西斯科、松阿伊西、松阿伊东（右）、松阿伊东、伊鲁欣西、中、东与达普达普西描笼涯公路更名为Isaac O. Tolentino大道
title.en: An Act Renaming the Road Traversing Barangays San Jose, Tolentino West, Tolentino East, Francisco, Sungay West (Left Side), Sungay East (Right Side), Sungay East, Iruhin West, Iruhin Central, Iruhin East and Dapdap West in the City of Tagaytay, Province of Cavite to Isaac O. Tolentino Avenue

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2018/ra_11046_2018.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The road traversing barangays San Jose, Tolentino West, Tolentino East, Sungay West (Leftside), Sungay East (Right side), Sungay East, Iruhin West, Iruhin Central, Iruhin East and Dapdap West in the City of Tagaytay, Province of Cavite is hereby renamed as Isaac O. Tolentino Avenue.
The Department of Public Works and Highways shall include in their annual budget the funds necessary for the implementation of this Act including posting and maintenance of signages thereat.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in at least two (2) newspapers of general circulation.
